subject: how to set threshold distance between markers

messages.author: 035d95299e14c533
messages.subject: how to set threshold distance between markers
parts:
Hi Karl,

How to set threshold distance between markers during genetic map construction in read.cross function?
For example I want to set 30 as a threshold distance between markers. So if there is a distance more than that another linkage group will be created for the same chromosome. 

Thanks
Kanat

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] how to set threshold distance between markers
parts:
There's not any way to do this. And I'd recommend against trying to estimate the map directly in read.cross().

Rather, read in the data using read.cross(), and then use est.rf(), formLinkageGroups(), orderMarkers(), ripple(), and switch.order(), with a lot of plots in between, to establish the linkage groups and order the markers.

karl
